questions.instructions: A service has no named owner. What should happen first?

criteria.assign_team: Assign a team as owner before any further work is scheduled against it
criteria.proceed_anyway: Proceed and assign an owner later if someone happens to notice

questions.note: Two options, to stay comparable with the default corpus.

questions.instructions: A risky change needs to reach production. Which rollout strategy?

criteria.canary: Canary to a small slice, watch metrics, then widen
criteria.blue_green: Stand up a parallel environment and cut over when it looks healthy
criteria.big_bang: Ship to everything at once during a quiet period

questions.note: Three options. Measures whether extra labels degrade either model.

questions.instructions: Checkout is failing for 30% of users in one region. Severity?

criteria.sev1: Sev 1: revenue is actively lost, page everyone and treat as all-hands
criteria.sev2: Sev 2: significant but bounded, page the on-call and mitigate today
criteria.sev3: Sev 3: degraded for some users, fix on the normal schedule

questions.instructions: A table needs a new NOT NULL column with no default. Which migration?

criteria.nullable_backfill: Add it nullable, backfill in batches, then add the constraint
criteria.default_instant: Add it with a constant default in a single statement
criteria.truncate_recreate: Write a new table with the constraint and copy rows over

questions.instructions: A test passes alone and fails in the suite. What is the likely cause?

criteria.shared_state: Shared state between tests, so isolate the fixture or reset it per test
criteria.machine_load: The machine is more loaded during the suite, so raise the timeout

questions.instructions: Debug logging is expensive. What should be reduced?

criteria.debug_only: Turn off debug, keep info and above
criteria.info_and_above: Turn off info as well, keep warnings only
criteria.sample_debug: Sample debug lines to a fraction and keep everything else

questions.instructions: An endpoint returns unbounded lists. What should it do?

criteria.paginate: Require a limit and return a cursor, defaulting to a small page
criteria.truncate: Return the first N silently and note the total separately

questions.instructions: A legacy module is painful to change. What is the right response?

criteria.incremental: Add tests at the seam and refactor in small steps as you touch it
criteria.rewrite: Rewrite the module in one pass against the current tests
criteria.leave: Leave it and add comments explaining the constraints

questions.instructions: Where should a database password live?

criteria.secret_manager: A secret manager, injected at runtime and never in the repo
criteria.env_file: A gitignored .env file on each host

questions.note: Both are defensible in small setups; the intended answer assumes a hosted secret store.

questions.instructions: Before refactoring an unmonitored service, what should come first?

criteria.instrument: Add metrics, logs and traces so the refactor has a baseline
criteria.refactor_first: Refactor first and add instrumentation afterwards
criteria.manual_checks: Add a manual runbook and check by hand after each change

questions.instructions: A flaky dependency causes clients to retry in lockstep. What prevents the storm?

criteria.jitter_backoff: Exponential backoff with jitter on the client
criteria.shorter_timeout: A shorter client timeout so retries happen sooner

questions.instructions: Two dependencies require incompatible versions of a shared library. What now?

criteria.pin_and_isolate: Pin one version and isolate the other behind an interface you own
criteria.force_resolve: Force the resolver to pick one and hope nothing breaks
criteria.drop_one: Drop whichever dependency is less central and rebuild

questions.instructions: A monolith is hard to deploy. What is the first step?

criteria.carve_service: Extract one well-bounded component behind a network boundary
criteria.split_all: Split the codebase into services along directory lines

questions.instructions: How should a library classify errors?

criteria.typed_hierarchy: A typed hierarchy the caller can match on, distinct from unexpected faults
criteria.strings: Error strings the caller pattern-matches, for simplicity

questions.note: Two labels despite the id, kept deliberately to compare 2-way and 4-way handling.

questions.instructions: A cold cache makes the first requests after deploy very slow. What helps?

criteria.prewarm: Prewarm the cache during deploy before shifting traffic
criteria.scale_up: Scale up the fleet so the slow first requests are absorbed
criteria.stagger: Stagger the deploy so instances warm at different times

questions.instructions: A deploy script fails halfway. What property matters most?

criteria.rerunnable: Running it again converges rather than compounding the damage
criteria.rollback: It can automatically restore the previous release

questions.instructions: Several services consume events from one producer. How should the contract be managed?

criteria.registry: A schema registry with compatibility checks in CI
criteria.wiki: A wiki page documenting the event shapes
criteria.implicit: Consumers read the producer's code and rely on tests

questions.instructions: A downstream call has no timeout. What is the risk?

criteria.exhaustion: Threads pile up waiting on a call that never returns, exhausting the pool
criteria.slow_only: Requests are merely slow, which the load balancer absorbs

questions.instructions: How should on-call handoffs work between people?

criteria.written_summary: A written summary of open incidents and recent changes, read aloud
criteria.verbal_only: A verbal walkthrough, since writing it up wastes time

questions.instructions: A build produces different bytes for the same source. What is the fix?

criteria.pin_inputs: Pin every input including timestamps and toolchain versions
criteria.retry: Rebuild until the output matches the previous one

questions.instructions: When should a feature flag be removed?

criteria.after_full_rollout: Once the rollout is complete and the old path is dead
criteria.never: Never, so the flag can gate a future rollback
criteria.quarterly: On a fixed quarterly schedule regardless of rollout state

questions.instructions: Backups run nightly and have never been restored. What is the real state?

criteria.unproven: There is no backup until a restore has been verified end to end
criteria.fine: The backups exist on disk, which is the same thing

questions.instructions: A public API adds an optional field. What is required of consumers?

criteria.nothing: Nothing, since it is optional and additive
criteria.regenerate: Regenerate client types and redeploy before relying on it

questions.instructions: A load balancer sends a user's requests to different instances and sessions break. Fix?

criteria.externalize: Store session state outside the instances so any can serve any request
criteria.sticky: Turn on sticky sessions so a user stays on one instance

questions.instructions: Two messages for the same account must be processed in order. What guarantees it?

criteria.partition_key: Partition the queue by account id so one consumer sees them in order
criteria.priority: Give them a higher priority so they are processed first
criteria.single_consumer: Use a single consumer thread for the whole queue

questions.instructions: A test is slow, flaky, and asserts almost nothing. What first?

criteria.delete: Delete it; a slow flaky test with no signal is worse than no test
criteria.quarantine: Quarantine it and keep it for reference

questions.instructions: A cache would cut p99 latency but adds a dependency. What decides it?

criteria.measure: Measure whether latency is actually a problem before adding the dependency
criteria.add_it: Add the cache, since lower latency is usually worth it

questions.instructions: A feature flag's value must not be visible to users. What applies?

criteria.server_only: Resolve the flag server-side so the value never reaches the client
criteria.client_visible: Ship the flag to the client for instant evaluation, obfuscated

questions.instructions: Reporting queries are slowing down the primary. What is the first move?

criteria.replica: Point reads at a replica and accept the staleness
criteria.index: Add indexes and rewrite the queries before adding infrastructure
criteria.shard: Shard the primary to spread the write and read load

questions.instructions: Deploys drop in-flight requests. What is missing?

criteria.drain: Stop accepting new work, finish in-flight work, then exit
criteria.restart_fast: Exit faster so the orchestrator starts the new instance sooner

questions.instructions: A dynamic codebase is hard to refactor. What helps most?

criteria.types_at_edges: Add types at the module boundaries so the core can be checked
criteria.no_types: Types are not the bottleneck; write tests first

questions.instructions: On-call receives 200 alerts a night and acts on two. What first?

criteria.prune: Delete alerts that have never led to action and page only on user impact
criteria.more_rotation: Add people to the rotation so the load is shared

questions.instructions: A consumer breaks because a producer renamed a field. Prevention?

criteria.contract_tests: Contract tests run in the producer's CI against real consumers
criteria.changelog: A changelog the consumers are expected to read

questions.instructions: A migration partially applied and the deploy retried. What property saves it?

criteria.check_first: The migration checks its own preconditions and skips work already done
criteria.fresh_db: Recreate the database from scratch and replay everything

questions.instructions: A request must return in 200ms and calls three services. What should exist?

criteria.budget_split: A per-dependency time budget derived from the 200ms total
criteria.global_timeout: A single timeout on the whole request

questions.instructions: Usernames can contain emoji and combining characters. What is the risk?

criteria.normalization: Visually identical names can be distinct byte strings, so normalise deliberately
criteria.none: Modern databases handle Unicode correctly out of the box

questions.instructions: A canary looks fine but the sample is small. What should happen?

criteria.size_first: Size the sample for the effect you want to detect before reading results
criteria.judge_now: If it looks fine, widen the rollout

questions.instructions: A function has a docstring that restates its name. What is better?

criteria.why_and_contract: Document the contract, the invariants and why, not the mechanics
criteria.longer_docstring: A longer docstring covering every parameter and return

questions.instructions: One message fails to process and blocks the queue behind it. Fix?

criteria.dlq: Move it to a dead-letter queue after a retry budget and alert
criteria.skip: Drop the message silently so the queue keeps moving

questions.instructions: CI is configured to run only on the main branch. Problem?

criteria.no_premerge: Bugs are found after merge, when they are most expensive
criteria.none: Main is the branch that matters, so testing it is sufficient

questions.instructions: Event data must be kept for a year but is expensive to store. What first?

criteria.tier_by_age: Keep hot data recent and roll older partitions to cheap storage
criteria.drop_oldest: Delete the oldest data to fit the budget
criteria.compress: Compress everything and keep it all

questions.instructions: A nightly job must run at 02:00 in the user's local time. What is the trap?

criteria.dst_and_travel: DST shifts and travel make local time ambiguous; store the intent in a timezone
criteria.none: Storing the offset is enough since offsets never change

questions.instructions: Blue-green deploys double infrastructure cost during cutover. When are they worth it?

criteria.irreversible: When a rollback must be instant and the change is hard to reverse
criteria.always: For every release, since the safety is worth the cost

questions.instructions: A metric is labelled with the full request path. What happens?

criteria.cardinality: The series count explodes and the metrics backend falls over
criteria.none: Labels are free, so this is always fine
